The '''Kashyyyk Spiritblade''' was a [[Sword/Legends|bladed weapon]] used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] acquired a Kashyyyk Spiritblade aboard the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] before the station's destruction.

==Behind the scenes==
The Kashyyyk Spiritblade appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
